messages:
anna: quick sync note: our dedicated-pool autoscaler often picks node types that fragment heavily when admission is mixed. thinking of a minimal API `/mosaic-recs` where runtime returns a tiny ranked list of concrete MIG templates + short scores (util_range, frag_delta, warmup_s, preempt_risk) so operator can make a cost tradeoff without loading models.

devon: sounds pragmatic. opt-in per-pool? operator passes pending admission snapshot and a `hard_constraint` flag for full-gpu support.

sam: yeah opt-in. also add `ttl` on recs and a `confidence` label to avoid flip-flop churn. operator should only switch template if confidence is med|high and ttl expired.

leah: preemption granularity varies by split (1/4 vs full). include `eviction_impact` ordinal and `est_evictions_per_hour` so operator maps to cost ledger.

anna: runtime impl note: avoid model instantiation. use cached perf profiles + seq-length histograms. coalesce hints like "pair 1/4+1/4 -> 1/2" would be super helpful; keep them as indexes into pending list.

sam: testing: 1) offline sim with historical admission traces; 2) canary pool with pack_opt_in true; 3) metric watchdog to revert if pinned-job p99 latency regresses >5% in 10m.

devon: telemetry additions: `mosaic_recs_requests`, `template_choice_rate`, `frag_delta_post_launch`. operator should report the post-launch frag delta back to runtime for learning.

leah: rollout: per-pool feature flag, default off. include kill-switch and automatic rollback on SLO regressions.

ops-bot: infra note: rate-limit endpoint to 1req/s per pool; idempotent responses. created ticket INF-6301: "mosaic-recs: runtime node-template recommendations for mixed MIG packing".

anna: action items: i'll draft RFC + example JSON responses; sam: add sim job; leah: sanity-check eviction heuristic; devon: add operator hook for simple cost-fn using the returned fields. will post RFC in channel in a few hours :rocket:
